map.title: Interactive Map

eudr.label: EU 2023/1115
eudr.description: The EU Deforestation Regulation requires timber producers to submit due diligence statements from 2025. ForestManager generates your due diligence statements automatically from forest polygons and harvest data.
eudr.check2: Direct submission to the EU authority
eudr.check3: Proof of origin from forest polygons

step1.title: Draw forest polygons
step1.desc: Define areas on the map — automatically prepared as EU-compliant proof of origin.

step2.title: Fill in the statement
step2.desc: Enter species, volume, and harvest period — directly from your harvest data.

step3.title: Submit
step3.desc: One click — the statement is transmitted and the reference number returned.

step4.title: Print delivery note
step4.desc: The reference number automatically appears on all delivery notes.

monitoring.label: Satellite Monitoring
monitoring.description: Weekly monitoring via Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-1. Bark beetle infestations, windthrow, and drought stress are detected before you visit the site.
